user_story: As a user, I want the system to handle an email with special characters correctly during registration so that valid edge-case emails are accepted.

positive.title: Register with a valid email containing special characters
steps: Input the email 'user+test@example.com' into the email field.
Fill in the other required fields.
positive.expected_result: The registration is successful, and the user receives a confirmation message.

negative.title: Attempt to register with an invalid email format
steps: Input the email 'user@.com' into the email field.
Fill in the other required fields.
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the email format is invalid and registration fails.

edge.title: Register with an email that has the maximum length allowed
steps: Input the email 'a...a@example.com' (where 'a' is repeated to reach maximum length) into the email field.
Fill in the other required fields.
edge.expected_result: The registration is successful, and the user receives a confirmation message.
